title: Canonical error → tonic::Status taxonomy (arch item H)
description: There is one canonical error → tonic::Status mapping for the gRPC surface, living in celnet-server::services::error_status (price_error_to_status, link_error_to_status, rates_price_error_to_status). Every RPC boundary reuses these; the resulting codes and messages are byte-identical to the pre-consolidation per-service mappings. This is the frozen-contract acceptance for the deliverable 'error-status-taxonomy'.

assertions.statement: price_error_to_status(&PriceError) -> tonic::Status is the single canonical PriceError→Status mapping used at every pricing RPC boundary; callers reuse it rather than re-mapping inline.
link_error_to_status(&LinkError) -> tonic::Status is the single canonical link/session error→Status mapping in the same error_status module.
rates_price_error_to_status(&RatesPriceError) -> tonic::Status is the single canonical rates-pricing error→Status mapping in the same error_status module.

The consolidated taxonomy is byte-identical to the former per-service mappings: every error variant yields the same tonic::Code and the same message string (the verbatim e.to_string()), so no client observes a changed code or message.
